task.behavior: A diagram can be read by hiding what is not the point and watched while it runs: components, lanes and connections can be hidden without touching the document, the walkthrough plays and pauses at a chosen speed and stops at the end, and a workflow or lifecycle can be run by firing its transitions from where the reading stands, with an event log and a reset.
acceptance: A component or lane can be hidden from the outline, which hides what it holds and the connections that would dangle, and everything hidden comes back in one click.
Every connection can be hidden at once without hiding a component.
Hiding never changes the document and leaves nothing to undo.
The walkthrough plays without further input, takes a speed, and stops at the last step instead of looping.
A run marks the state it stands on, offers only the transitions the document gives that state, moves when one is fired, logs what it fired and resets.
Firing a transition never writes to the document.
Walking and running clear the selection, and their step bar never sits under the viewport controls.
No card title breaks mid-word across the template set.
